stories.title: Define Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define structured schema for trial proximity including distance (miles/km), travel duration (minutes), origin, destination, routing status, and fallback indicators when routing fails.

stories.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Computation
stories.description: Implement logic to call Google Routes API to compute distance and travel time from user location to each clinical trial site, including batching, response caching, rate-limit handling, and graceful fallback behavior.

stories.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial results returned to the chat layer, ensuring schema alignment with contract.

stories.title: Integrate Proximity with Trial Location Extraction
stories.description: Apply proximity calculations across all extracted trial locations, normalize location inputs, and deterministically select the nearest site (distance primary, duration tie-breaker) for output.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculation
stories.description: Add tests covering distance/time computation, multi-site selection logic, missing or malformed location handling, API failure fallback, caching behavior, and end-to-end validation through the facade.
